summary.headline: HOEC Q1 FY27 standalone revenue rose to INR117.5 crore from negative INR194 crore, but PBT before exceptionals fell to INR12.5 crore on B-80 output loss and HPCL crude resale.
summary.overview: Standalone revenue from operations was INR117.5 crore versus a negative INR194 crore in Q4, which reflected reversal of the HPCL crude sale (INR259 crore). Kharsang output rose from about 12,300 to 17,400 BOE and crude realisation rose to about $95.5/bbl from $70.8/bbl. Standalone PBT before exceptionals fell to INR12.5 crore from INR30.4 crore, due to inventory-related cost offsets. B-80 output was hit by higher water cut, and the HPCL-stored crude is being resold to third parties at a slower pace than expected, with a further mark-to-market loss expected. Management is relying on debt to fund the B-80 workover and three-well programme.

segments.name: Kharsang (Arunachal, crude and gas)
segments.commentary: Output rose from about 12,300 to 17,400 BOE; nine-well programme doubled production year on year and workovers on 23 idle wells are underway (5-6 done). Gas is virgin and unsold for lack of pipeline.

segments.name: B-80 (offshore Mumbai)
segments.commentary: Production reduced by higher water cut from one producing well; compressor configuration changed and in test mode. Crude stored at HPCL Chembur is being sold via tankers; about 15% sold so far. Gas realisation around $15-16/MMBTU on exchange, average $16.5/MMBTU.

segments.name: Dirok (Assam, onshore)
segments.commentary: Operated with ~27% stake; currently producing only 50-70% of well capability due to evacuation limits. DNPL line capacity degraded to ~1-1.5 MMSCMD versus 2.5 MMSCMD design; average gas realisation about $12.5/MMBTU.

segments.name: PY-1 (East Coast, gas)
segments.commentary: Three wells suffered serious production loss; rig-less intervention contracted and funded from own books. Two new wells deferred and contingent on take-or-pay gas agreement with GAIL or IOCL. Realisation about $10-12/MMBTU.

segments.name: Cambay, Gujarat (Asjol, Balol, Palej)
segments.commentary: Palej debottlenecking delivered 5-6% production increase last quarter; management guides 20-30% increase over time. Sucker rod pumps ordered and a new exploration block pending final approval.

segments.name: B-15 (new block)
segments.commentary: Recoverable reserves 16 MMBOE; FDP under preparation with three to four concepts, including tie-back to ONGC platform. Drilling planned in FY28.

guidance_outlook: Dirok: DNPL capacity restoration via hot-tap expected by December 2026, targeted at 2.5 MMSCMD from 1-1.5 MMSCMD; locked-in volumes 0.5-0.7 MMSCMD gross.
B-80: two workovers in Oct-Nov 2026; three new wells (1,000-1,500 bbl/well per simulation, range 700-1,400 or 8,900-13,000 bbl total cited) by June 2027; workovers 500-800 bbl/well.
B-80 crude inventory at HPCL Chembur expected to clear by end-October/early November 2026; sales from FSO in October in 120,000-150,000 bbl tranches.
Management expects further mark-to-market loss of about 7-10% on the remaining HPCL crude; explicitly not guidance.
Kharsang: pipeline route survey tender closing; 24 km pipeline to Bordumsa; 14-18 months to complete; second phase of nine wells pending rig award and tubulars in 1-2 months.
Cash flows expected to fund B-15 by around Nov-Dec 2027; B-80 programme to be funded by debt being raised from market.
capex_capacity: B-80: rig award expected this month; workovers mobilised by October; three wells planned with production from June 2027; jacket and production deck installation required.
PY-1: two new wells deferred until a firm take-or-pay gas agreement; 15-20 MMSCFD potential cited from two wells.
Capex budget increased versus Q4 presentation, which management attributed to a contingency for rig scarcity; facility to be drawn down on need.
Kharsang pipeline: 24 km, 6-8 months for right of way plus 6-8 months for laying; target completion around December 2027 in best case.
Dirok: hot-tap works by Assam Gas Company Ltd and NRL bypass of about 150-200 m of pipeline inside NRL premises.
demand_pricing: Standalone crude/condensate realisation about $95.5/bbl vs $70.8/bbl previous quarter; benefited from favourable Brent.
Gas realisation blended $12/MMBTU vs $9.8 previous quarter; B-80 about $16.5/MMBTU, Dirok about $12.5/MMBTU.
Crude from B-80 resold to third parties; HPCL offtake continues by tanker with gantries added; realisation losses of INR4-6 crore incurred so far.
NRL can act as reseller and sell gas on exchange; management says gas can be sold within about three days once a credible grid path exists.
Oil sales to Digboi Refinery and mainly IOCL from Kharsang.
